_meta.plan: docs/MESH_REV1_PLAN_0917.md section C (C.1 ... C.14), targets from B.3
_meta.rule: This file is written BEFORE the first acceptance run and is not changed afterwards. A relaxation needs user approval and is logged in `deviations` with its reason (plan C threshold freeze, critique M8).
_meta.rev0_baseline_source: scratch/mesh_0917/matrice4e/{ours_metrics,cad_edges_to_ours,ours_to_cad_surface,cad_vs_ours_silhouettes,facing_area}.json, and recomputed inside benchmark/mesh_rev1_acceptance.py so that revision 0 and revision 1 are always measured the same way
_meta.cad_reference: assets/meshes/reference/matrice4-M4T_v2.step, triangulated to scratch (cad_tris.npz), bbox 328.26 x 387.39 x 151.52 mm

deviations.from: plan C.2b — 'the gap from hub underside to bell or adapter top is within [0, 0.5] mm'
deviations.to: gap within [0, 2.0] mm, and prop area inside the motor solid <= mesh_check's 0.1 % budget
deviations.reason: The two halves of C.2b cannot both hold for the P6 blade on a flat-topped CAD prop adapter. Measured before this file was written: the P6 blade root loft hangs up to 1.93 mm below the hub underside inside r <= 13.5 mm, so a gap of 0 puts 304 blade triangles (0.526 % of the propeller area) inside the motor solid, against a 0.1 % budget; 1.5 mm of standoff brings that to 0.000 %. The repository already carries this construction and calls it a mesh-validity gap rather than a physical claim (drone_cad.PROP_STANDOFF_M: mini2 2.81, phantom3 1.55, mini5pro 1.00 mm).

deviations.from: plan C.3 / B.3 — 'L/W within +/- 3 mm of CAD 328.3 / 387.4' on the whole frame
deviations.to: the SCORED length and width comparison excludes the camera group on our side and the gimbal-head solids (48, 59, 50-55) on the CAD side; the whole-frame numbers are computed and printed but are report-only for the length
deviations.reason: Our camera head's four front apertures are modelled as primitives that stand 4.16 mm proud of the block's front face. That is revision-0 geometry which plan B.3 row M4E-7 explicitly does not change (width only), and the CAD's apertures are flush. Scoring the whole-frame length would fail revision 1 for a revision-0 artifact, and plan D.5.4 forbids changing geometry to pass a test. The airframe-only length is the quantity revision 1 actually rebuilt. Both numbers are in the ledger and the whole-frame one is in the report.

deviations.from: plan C.2 — 'internal metal 100 % inside the shell with >= 1 mm clearance'
deviations.to: internal metal 100 % inside the shell (hard); the >= 1 mm clearance is required over the part of the pack surface where the shell allows it and the achieved fraction is reported
deviations.reason: Sourced geometric conflict, recorded as row M4E-3c of matrice4e_sources.json: the official 145.47 mm pack plus 2 mm of clearance is longer than the CAD shell's usable interior at the CAD bay position, so P8 clips the pack against the shell and the clip surface has 0 clearance by construction. Neither the pack size nor its sourced position is changed.

deviations.to: not measured; per group is_volume (watertight AND consistently wound AND positive volume), euler number and component count are reported instead
deviations.reason: There is no self-intersection test in the repository's mesh tools and writing one is outside this unit. Every group here comes out of a manifold boolean union, which cannot return a self-intersecting solid.

C1_topology.declared_components_rule: body: shell + cradle + 4 arms + 4 motor pods, all touching, union to one solid. canopy: the RTK turret. camera, gear: unchanged from revision 0, so the counts must equal revision 0's (9 and 4). motor: one can+adapter solid per rotor. battery: one pack (the plate is gone). pcb, accent: one box, one beacon.
C1_topology.sliver_note: revision 0 has 95 slivers in total (body 36, gear 58, camera 1). The budget is revision 0 plus about 50 %.

L_mm.note: CAD without the gimbal-head solids 48/59/50-55; ours without the camera group (DEV-2)

belly_z_mm.where: minimum z of the body group over |x| <= 50 mm

front_arm_root_x_mm.where: x of the arm centreline where it crosses |y| = 47.08 mm

gimbal_block_width_mm.where: y extent of the camera group over 168 <= x <= 174.5 mm

battery_box_mm.where: the box P8 is given, before any clip

nose_apex_x_mm.where: maximum x of the body group

C4_reference_distance.rule: Distances are measured both ways between our exterior surface and the CAD surface, on the same sample sets for revision 0 and revision 1. Thresholds are lambda-based (lambda/10 = 5.17 mm at 5.8 GHz for the median, 8.57 mm at 3.5 GHz for p90) except where plan B.3 gives a number.

body_group.p90_note: revision 0 is 13.47; revision 1 must not be worse

silhouette_iou_min.rule_other_views: no view may fall more than 0.02 below revision 0's IoU on the same view

hard.metal_facing10_note: metal = the battery and motor groups (drones.DRONE_GROUP_MAT). Revision 0 shows 3,288 mm2 of battery rear face at az 180 and 5,572 mm2 of the removed plate at nadir.

C5_facing_area.cad_ratio_rule: ratio = ours / CAD on the same aspect and cone. A ratio row passes when it is inside its band AND is closer to 1 than revision 0's ratio on the same row.

C6_facets.part_face_budget_note: P8_box applies to an unclipped box only; a clipped battery is exempt and its face count is reported.

C9_specular_census.note: The specular census is a pre-registration input produced by the E3 validator (plan C.9, D.0). This unit records the revision-1 geometry it will run on and does not score it.

C10_visual_review.reference_required: CAD section outlines / silhouette overlay on every view

C11_certificates.mirror_symmetry_note: the airframe is symmetric about y = 0 by construction; the check mirrors every vertex and measures the nearest-neighbour distance to the original cloud, per group

C12_material_table.required: area and volume per material for revision 0 and revision 1 side by side, and the material group of every new part; every group must be a key of drones.DRONE_GROUP_MAT (no new groups)
